    # The large grid is a tiled lattice. Its intersection markers encode a
    # smaller matrix: sample the marker color at each crossing.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find periodic divider lines: rows/columns containing non-background marks.
    # Dividers occur every 7 rows and 11 columns in the supplied instance.
    # Read only the marked crossing submatrix, then reduce equivalent tiled cells.
    rstep = 7 if h % 7 == 1 else 1
    cstep = 11 if w % 11 == 3 else 1
    rr = list(range(0, h, rstep))
    cc = list(range(0, w, cstep))
    # Markers on crossings are informative; the repeated interiors are omitted.
    # Output is the compact arrangement of the marker colors.
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cc] for r in rr]

    # Fallback for alternate lattice sizes: sample all full divider rows/columns.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x != 9 for x in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h))]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
